note: Plain-text word-list sources. Add an entry with id, title, url and citation, then run `npm run fetch-lexicons`; the script vendors the file verbatim to docs/lexicons/<id>.txt and records its checksum. The site never fetches these URLs at runtime.

sources.title: Offensive/Profane Word List
sources.author: Luis von Ahn's Research Group, Carnegie Mellon University
sources.citation: Luis von Ahn's Research Group. Offensive/Profane Word List. Carnegie Mellon University. https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~biglou/resources/bad-words.txt
sources.description: A list of 1,300+ English terms that could be found offensive. The publisher notes that it contains some words that many people won't find offensive.
sources.license_note: No license is stated by the publisher. Redistributed unmodified with attribution for research and personal filtering; remove it if the publisher objects.
